conversation_log.content:
Looking back at your physical history, which of these domains best describes the foundation of your athletic journey?
Options: [Strength-focused disciplines like powerlifting or heavy athletics. | Team sports where impact and explosive movement define the rhythm. | Combat sports, emphasizing leverage, reaction speed, and tactical intensity.]
Strength-focused disciplines like powerlifting or heavy athletics.

When you approach your training sessions, which aspect of your craft do you find most central to your personal success?
Options: [The pursuit of raw, absolute power—moving the heaviest weight possible. | The refinement of explosive velocity—generating maximum force in the shortest window. | The technical mastery—the mental and physical precision required to execute complex heavy lifts.]
The pursuit of raw, absolute power—moving the heaviest weight possible.

In your high-performance sporting journey, which environment do you feel brings out the best in your competitive nature?
Options: [The solitary iron sanctuary—focusing entirely on the grind, the silence, and your own personal bests. | The pressurized arena—thriving under the gaze of a crowd and the heat of head-to-head competition. | The training hall community—drawing energy from peers and coaches who share the relentless pursuit of strength.]
The pressurized arena—thriving under the gaze of a crowd and the heat of head-to-head competition.
With these insights gathered, I am ready to outline your path in high-performance sport. Would you like to reveal the journey ahead?
Let's see if your algorithm can handle a real athlete or if it’s just going to tell me to go for a jog.

scouting_result.pathway_adaptive: Seated Shot Put (e.g., Men's Shot Put C3)
scouting_result.scout_verdict:
Your foundation in strength-focused disciplines finds its ultimate expression in the circle, where your 142kg frame acts as the engine for kinetic force. At 35, you possess the seasoned composure to thrive in the pressurized arena of The LA28 Games. The explosive, rotational demand of the shot put and discus perfectly mirrors your pursuit of raw, absolute power, turning every throw into a testament of explosive mass.

In the adaptive pathway, you would compete in the C3 classification. This category is designed for athletes who compete from a specialized, fixed-frame throwing chair, which effectively stabilizes the torso to isolate the immense power generated by the upper body. For a power-lifter of your stature, this creates a unique challenge: instead of relying on full-body momentum, you must master the mechanics of total force production from a static, seated position. It is an exercise in absolute technical control, where the roar of the crowd provides the only feedback you need as you launch the implement toward the horizon.

While the throwing field captures your explosive intensity, the Mat Technician archetype focuses on the granular science of movement. Here, your desire for raw, absolute power is filtered through the lens of technical mastery. In the arena, you are not just pushing weight; you are engaging in a tactical struggle against the bar, where every adjustment in your grip or leverage determines your standing at The LA28 Games.

Your adaptive path in the +100 kg Powerlifting class is not merely about strength; it is a discipline of endurance under maximum load. Unlike the explosive, rotational release of field events, this path demands a sustained, unwavering focus—a 'solitary sanctuary' approach applied to the heaviest weights imaginable. By emphasizing the precise mechanical alignment required for the bench press and the deadlift, this pathway honors your history of heavy lifting while shifting the emphasis from projectile velocity to absolute, controlled capacity under pressure.
